VTABLE LABELS: labelled off_C006C4 = sCamera::vftable and off_BC8C34 = uCamera::vftable (from getDTI stubs and DTI registration), plus every class's MyDTI vtable (set at DTI registration `mov X::DTI, offset ...`): sCamera 0xC00704, sCamera::Viewport 0xC006FC, rDevilCamera 0xB9B81C, rCameraList 0xC0B414, uFreeCamera 0xC04488, uMotionCamera 0xC09AF8, uMotionCameraBoss 0xBF5E08, uIdCamera 0xBDBE0C, uEfctCam 0xBC9418, uModelCam 0xBE0D40. uCamera and uDevilCamera are abstract in DX9: their DTIs use the generic abstract-DTI vtable 0xB8E3B0 (labelled sDevil4Pad::vftable_0, which is wrong, but left as is because it is shared). DEFINED 15 functions from undefined loc_ code (deleting dtors + MyDTI::newInstance): 0x8E5DC0 0x8EBBD0 0x8E5B60 0x8EBAA0 0x469790 0x469800 0xAADF20 0xAADF70 0xA7FC40 0xA7FD60 0x8816B0 0x749480 0x539230 0x788F80 0x788FD0. ICF / SHARED: 0x49B290 is the generic cTrans-level deleting dtor (slot 0 of about 36 vtables, including uCamera/uDevilCamera/uFreeCamera/uIdCamera). It is recorded but not renamed or defined. 0x749630 (5-byte jmp uDevilCamera::sync) is slot 8 of uCameraBoss and every uIdCamera-derived vtable. Group C had commented it as uCameraBoss::sync without renaming it. I renamed it uIdCamera::sync because it sits in the uIdCamera TU, and prepended an ICF comment that lists both. 0x73F870 (jmp uDevilCamera::createProperty) is slot 3 of uIdCamera and 6 derived vtables; renamed uIdCamera::createProperty, matching SE, where the derived classes reuse uIdCamera::createProperty. 0xA7FD60 is the deleting dtor of both uMotionCamera and uMotionCameraBoss (ICF comment). 0x539290 (uEfctCam slot 0) is shared by uDevil4Effect/uEffectVFR/uEfctEasyShadow/uEfctFootPrint, so it was not renamed. SE-ONLY: rCameraList::CAMERA_INFO (4 getters; no DX9 DTI, and DX9 uMotionCamera::move has no nMotion key calls). The SE-only virtuals applyWorldOffset, getWorldTargetPos and moveAfter have no DX9 slots; DX9 uCamera::move 0xA52330 does the frustum update that SE does in moveAfter + sCamera::updateViewportFrustum (medium, comment only). sCamera::draw and sCamera::clearBlank have no DX9 counterpart. Viewport::updateFrustum and many small accessors are inlined. rCameraListXml (DX9-only, not in SE scope): DTI rCameraListXml::DTI parent rCameraList, size 0xC68, vtable 0xC0B41C (13 slots, getExt 'lcm.xml'), MyDTI vtable off_C0B46C; nested rCameraListXml::CameraInfo (size 0xC, MtObject, vtable 0xC0B450, MyDTI off_C0B464). Its code is at 0xAADEE0-0xAAF2DC (e.g. createProperty 0xAAEAC0 'CameraMotion'/'mCameraList', CameraInfo createProperty 0xAAE820). It is not renamed. Note: 0xAAE9B0 (references rCameraList::vftable) is in the rCameraListXml code. PRE-EXISTING NAMES FOR THE COORDINATOR: 0x404CA0 'uFreeCamera::newInstance' is not a MyDTI::newInstance (real one is 0x9197A0). It is a spawn helper that creates a free camera and calls setRegion/setCamera/addBottom; left untouched. The names uDevilCamera::resolveMovement (0x4C3B00) and uDevilCamera::move_tick* (0x4CC350, 0x4CE210, 0x4D49A0, 0x4DB710, 0x4E0E40, 0x4E4EF0, 0x4ED310, 0x4F1570) in the uCameraBoss* TUs do not correspond to any SE uDevilCamera method. They are probably uCameraBoss*/uCameraCtrl code and should be reconciled by groups C/D/E. uDevilCamera::createProperty 0x4C1E10 sits inside the uCameraBoss TU region, but uDevilCamera vtable slot 3 and the strings confirm it.
